chunks: Those who remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and who reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth, (saying): 'Our Lord, You have not created this in vain; exalted are You, so protect us from the punishment of the Fire.'
ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the faithful regarding remembrance and contemplation in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to validate the spiritual status of contemplation (tafakkur) alongside ritual prayer, emphasizing that intellectual engagement with the cosmos is a form of worship. The phrase 'on their sides' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to include both the posture of night prayer (Qiyam al-Layl) and moments of rest, illustrating that dhikr permeates all states of being. This continuous mindfulness serves as a shield against heedlessness, directly linking cosmic awareness to the ultimate hope for deliverance from the Fire.
